puzzle.family: Construction family: standard, pairwise, cross_attribute, equality_tree, branching, redundant_paths. Family-specific enabled types must remain available. A family is not a difficulty guarantee.
puzzle.assignment_mode: repeated permits shared attribute values; distinct requires at least suspect_count active values in every domain and forbids equality families.
puzzle.extra_clue_scope: all samples from all attributes; non_target_attributes requires branching/equality_tree and at least two attributes.
puzzle.attribute_mismatches: Optional integer 1..number of attributes; only redundant_paths. Controls how many attribute anchors differ from the culprit.
puzzle.config.suspect_count: Integer 2..64 suspects. More suspects increase encoding size and subset search; no universal accuracy prediction.
puzzle.config.domains: Map of 1..8 nonempty attribute names to 2..32 distinct strings. Domains may contain unicode/quotes. Changing values changes the world identity. Default lists are printed in the resolved configuration.
puzzle.config.clue_count: Positive integer core reports, before evidence transformations. Must cover all configured minima. Equality constructions require at least suspect_count; redundant_paths requires (suspect_count+1)*attributes.
puzzle.config.enabled_types: Nonempty unique list of the ten supported clue predicates. Constructed families require their named predicates; see predicate reference.
puzzle.config.alpha: Sampling weight/control in [0,1]. Direct category weight alpha; indirect category weight 1-alpha. Construction also uses alpha when choosing available direct versus relational anchors. Rejection and availability condition these weights.
puzzle.config.beta: Conditional positive relationship weight in [0,1] within indirect sampling, with complement for negative relationships. Availability and rejection alter realized frequencies; not a measured difficulty slider.
puzzle.config.min_murderer_links: Nonnegative integer lower bound on murderer-link reports, at most clue_count. Hard accepted-case filter.
puzzle.config.max_murderer_links: Optional nonnegative integer upper bound, no smaller than the minimum. Impossible limits exhaust candidates.
puzzle.config.max_positive_murderer_link: Optional nonnegative cap on positive murderer links; may conflict with available family anchors.
puzzle.config.min_indirect_clues: Nonnegative minimum number of indirect reports, at most clue_count. Requires enabled indirect types.
puzzle.config.min_unique_subset_size: Positive minimum sufficient subset size, at most clue_count. Community sufficient bounds cannot undercut this legacy minimum.
puzzle.config.require_indirect_essential: Boolean hard requirement: at least one indirect clue is essential; impossible with no indirect types.
puzzle.config.min_pairwise_clues: Nonnegative required suspect-comparison count, at most clue_count. May reject unsupported families.
puzzle.config.active_values_per_attribut: Optional integer 2..smallest domain size. Distinct assignment also requires at least suspect_count active values.
puzzle.config.reasoning_route: standard, pairwise or cross_attribute legacy construction route. Keep standard for equality constructions; family and route must agree.
puzzle.config.max_attempts: Positive bounded legacy construction attempts per candidate; increasing it costs solver time and does not relax semantic filters.
puzzle.config.mutation_steps: Nonnegative legacy search mutation steps. Zero skips mutation; it does not skip certification.
puzzle.config.max_solver_calls: Positive maximum legacy solver calls. Exhaustion means unresolved, never a proof.
puzzle.config.solver_seconds: Positive per-solve wall-time seconds in legacy construction. Timeouts mean unresolved.
puzzle.config.solver_work: Positive CP-SAT deterministic work bound. Engine-specific effort units; unrelated to model reasoning depth.
puzzle.config.generation_seconds: Positive total legacy generation wall-time seconds. Independent of community certification_seconds.
evidence.minimum_sufficient_clues: Optional nonnegative certified lower bound in reports. Must not exceed maximum or undercut legacy minimum; ambiguous cases forbid it.
evidence.maximum_sufficient_clues: Optional nonnegative certified upper bound in reports; ambiguous cases forbid a sufficient subset.
evidence.entailed_clues: Nonnegative count of extra core-entailed reports. Can improve redundancy and model performance; increases text and certification cost.
evidence.connected_decoys: Nonnegative count of extra relational entailed reports connected to target variables. Different from independent nuisance.
evidence.irrelevant_records: Nonnegative count of satisfiable independent one-variable components, appended by default. Above 1000 requires large_corpus=true. Increases export and model input cost.
evidence.false_reports: Integer 0..2 actual sampled corruptions; private evaluator information. Cannot exceed corruption_allowance.
evidence.corruption_allowance: Optional integer 0..2 public at-most-k rule; resolves to false_reports when omitted. At most is not exactly k.
evidence.answerability: unique or ambiguous after all reports and the reliability rule. Ambiguous requires null sufficient bounds and null minimum coalition size.
evidence.corruption_strategy: random or targeted. Targeted false reports require unique answerability and may increase solver search.
evidence.corruption_search_attempts: Positive targeted-search attempt cap. Exhaustion retains rejection evidence; never implies success.
evidence.maximum_alternative_margin: Optional positive maximum alternative reliability margin; requires unique answerability. Extra solver profiling cost.
distribution.agent_count: Integer 1..8. Explicitly use one for single-agent work; default two. Coalition enumeration grows exponentially.
distribution.shared_reports: Nonnegative count visible to every agent, no larger than total report count.
distribution.private_replication: Integer 1..max(1,agent_count-1) owners per non-shared report; repeated presentation retains original report identity.
distribution.per_agent_quotas: Optional exact nonnegative report counts, one per agent. Must be feasible with sharing and replication; impossible quotas reject candidates.
distribution.minimum_coalition_size: Optional integer 1..agent_count. Hard certified minimum team size; null for globally ambiguous data.
distribution.max_attempts: Positive bounded partition-search retries; more retries cost certification time, not a relaxed quota.
presentation.theme: mystery or investigation. Uses Person/Entity labels, deterministic wording and no LLM.
presentation.naming_seed: Integer seed for label permutation, independent of the sampled world; labels are not real people.
presentation.template: compact or expanded deterministic report wording. Expanded adds a fixed sentence to each report.
presentation.clue_order: shuffle, canonical or reverse. Shuffle uses a deterministic seed; canonical sorts report hashes.
presentation.evidence_placement: front, middle, end or interleaved position of core reports within the independent nuisance stream.
presentation.minimum_words: Optional nonnegative minimum whitespace word count. Adds explicitly nonfactual template padding when necessary.
presentation.maximum_words: Optional nonnegative maximum whitespace word count. Evidence is never truncated; impossible bounds reject.
presentation.minimum_tokens: Optional nonnegative lower token bound. Requires Python tokenizer with stable identity and workers=1; not provider chat billing.
presentation.maximum_tokens: Optional nonnegative upper token bound; same tokenizer constraints. Overflow rejects instead of shortening reports.
dataset.count: Positive accepted-world target. Candidate exhaustion writes incomplete status and CLI exits 2.
dataset.seed: Nonnegative first candidate seed; candidates increase in deterministic order. Resume reuses recorded candidate receipts.
dataset.workers: Positive process count. Does not change config fingerprint or accepted seed order. Custom tokenizer requires one worker.
dataset.splits: development/test/transfer proportions, finite nonnegative values summing to one. Hash-based allocation keeps paired worlds together.
dataset.holdout_families: List of valid families forced to transfer split; family holdout is not a proof of strategy diversity.
dataset.output_directory: Nonempty local directory. Existing matching checkpoints resume; source/config drift rejects. Keep frozen measured runs separate.
dataset.certification_seconds: Positive community certification wall-time seconds per candidate. Includes coalition checks; unresolved timeouts reject.
dataset.max_solver_calls: Positive community certification call budget. Separate from nested legacy generation controls.
dataset.max_candidates_per_case: Positive candidate multiplier; total attempted candidates bounded by count times this value.
dataset.large_corpus: Boolean explicit opt-in for more than 1000 independent records. Does not authorize inference or raise any monetary cap.
schema_version: Exact wire contract clue-community-1. Separate from software and presentation identity; stale schemas are rejected.
